definitions.gloss: to clear, to pass, to meet (a requirement)
definitions.explanation: To successfully overcome, complete, or satisfy a condition, goal, or standard.
Being see-through, transparent, or clean in appearance.

notes:
From English "clear." Very versatile in Japanese, used as a suru verb, na-adjective, and in compounds.

SENSE 1 — TO CLEAR/PASS:
Extremely common in gaming (clearing a stage/game) and in business (meeting standards or conditions).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧クリア⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clear/beat a game
- ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧クリア⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to meet conditions
- ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧クリア⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reach a goal
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧クリア⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to overcome a problem

SENSE 2 — CLEAR/TRANSPARENT:
Used for visual or auditory clarity.

COMPOUNDS:
- クリアファイル: clear plastic file folder (ubiquitous office supply in Japan)
- クリア⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: clear skin
